source_label.label: BUGGY_ON_SUCCESSFUL_ALLOCATION
source_label.rationale: new Wrapping() value-initializes the nested integer array. The return copies a pointer-free Nested object, not an ownership handle. No release or pointer escape follows successful allocation, so the helper loses its allocation. A throwing allocation creates no acquired object. Caller does not own a second leak.
source_label.language_boundary: Header-free C++17 translation unit; ordinary global single-object new/delete, no allocator replacement or interposition. Visible aggregate operations introduce no custom copy or destructor cleanup. Original simulator-harness equivalence is not claimed; this is source-level ownership semantics, not measured runtime allocation.
